sources_considered.why: Primary measurement of advertising placements provides relevant background, but its observation period and population differ from the claim.
Read the study. Its product-review search sample and pooled observations extending through September 2023 do not establish internet-wide prevalence during the target period.
Read the contemporary reporting. Its business examples support the narrower content-production claim assessed separately, but cannot settle this broader characterization.

evidence_items.locator: Additional Key Findings, Made for Advertising websites
evidence_items.explanation: The study documents substantial exposure to sites made for advertising among participating advertisers. Its observations cover September 2022 through January 2023, and advertising impressions do not measure the prevalence of the specified content across the internet.

unresolved_gaps: No representative measurement found establishes the prevalence and quality of the specified content across ordinary internet use during June 2023.
The available studies measure narrower populations or different periods.
The speaker supplies no boundary between widespread low-quality material and an internet characterized by it.
